loss_reason: Closed-lost to Together - lower quoted TCO for dedicated + easier on-premized model hosting. Security concerns around our private binary delivery timeline.
notes:
Deal status: Closed-lost to Together (confirmed 2026-02-20).

Key stakeholders: CTO (Priya Nair), Head of ML Ops (Daniel Park), Procurement lead (Anita Gomez), Security (Lead: Marcus Lee).

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-08-14: Lead created from trade show follow-up (retail AI summit).
- 2025-09-02: Intro call (AE: Maya Chen) - high intent, POC discussed; prioritizes low-latency recommendations in-store.
- 2025-10-01: NDA signed, security questionnaire shared (drive:/security/saffron-security-faq.md).
- 2025-11-10: Architecture deep-dive w/ SE (Liam O'Connor) - talked about KV-caching, autoscaling, and model routing.
- 2026-01-05: POC kickoff - 6-week POC to validate latency (target p95 < 120ms) and embedding throughput for nightly re-rank jobs.
- 2026-02-05: Final POC review (recording ff_2026-02-05_8b3a). POC met latency targets but security asked for signed attestation on private binary delivery.
- 2026-02-12: Procurement received competing bids (Together, Replicate). Together proposed a hybrid private-cloud appliance + managed control plane; lower 3-year TCO.
- 2026-02-20: Procurement notified AE that vendor selection is Together.

Customer quotes / paraphrases:
- "We liked Redwood's runtime — latency was solid — but procurement is pushing for the vendor that can ship a local appliance faster." — Head of MLOps, Daniel Park.
- "Security can't sign off on the timeline for custom binary vetting; they want vendor-provided appliance or an air-gapped option." — Marcus Lee (Security).

Why we lost (root causes):
- Price / TCO: Together bid came in materially lower for 3-year committed plan after appliance discount.
- Deployment expectation mismatch: Customer wanted a turn-key on-prem appliance; Together had an appliance pilot already approved by their security team.
- Security cadence: Our private binary delivery / attestation timeline (3-4 weeks extra) was a blocker for their go-live date.
- Internal champion waned: Initial executive sponsor moved to another initiative in Q1.

Competitive notes:
- Together: won on appliance + pricing + security pre-clearance.
- Replicate: evaluated for simplicity and embeddings API but lacked enterprise SLAs.

Next steps / follow-ups attempted:
- AE sent "post-mortem" email and asked to keep Redwood on shortlist for a 6-month review window (gmail_2026_02_05_thread_abc123).
- SE logged technical notes / POC artifacts to drive:/deals/saffron/ for internal learning.
- Suggested winback play: offer 90-day pilot discount + expedited private-binary attestation lane, target outreach 2026-05.

Internal reminders / action items:
- Create internal post-mortem (owner: Maya) - include pricing comparison and security timeline chart.
- Flag account for partner-led re-introduction if Together shows gaps in latency/cost in Q3.
- Add to "lost to competitor" cohort for analysis (INF-1129, SEC-453).

Misc: POC logs attached to INF-1129, security questions tracked in SEC-453. Notes intentionally choppy — CRM style.
